question: The mode and median of a data are 27.6 and 28, respectively. What is the mean of the data? (Use empirical formula.)4241
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the empirical formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

⇒ 2 × Mean = (3 × Median) − Mode

⇒ 2 × Mean = (3 × 28) − 27.6

⇒ 2 × Mean = 84 − 27.6 = 56.4

⇒ Mean = 28.2

**∴ The correct answer is 28.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Median = 28
